abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions genuinely stretch: an Items section would reuse Section/CardList/TypeBadge, the api helpers, and the data-driven table pattern with only a thin copy of the moves page skeleton. The one real copy-paste seam is home-page card construction.

findings.issue: Card construction is duplicated between the home load and cardsFor (app/src/lib/server/api.ts:121-132); the Card shape, humanized label and sprite rules exist in two places, so any change to cards must be made twice and can drift
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared card builder (e.g. `cardsForSpecies([...])` or a `makeCard(id, name, extra)` helper in lib/server/api.ts) and have the home load use it

findings.issue: The home load is one monolithic function mixing type-index construction, filtering, pagination and card building in the route file, untestable and unshareable
findings.suggestion: Move the type→species index and filtering into lib/server/api.ts (or a lib/server/pokedex.ts), leaving the load to parse URL params and slice pages

findings.issue: Effect-fallback logic (short_effect → flavor text → —) is near-duplicated in the abilities load (app/src/routes/abilities/[name]/+page.server.ts:17-19) with subtle differences ($effect_chance substitution)
Imports use the `#lib/*` package subpath alias instead of SvelteKit's built-in `$lib`, which every SvelteKit contributor expects
findings.suggestion: Switch to `$lib/...` imports (or at minimum document the choice); the vite/plugin tooling treats $lib as first-class

findings.issue: Removing the abilities feature leaves dead code behind: Card.hidden (types.ts), the is_hidden propagation in cardsFor, and the 'Hidden ability' span in CardList.svelte:18-20 exist only for it
findings.suggestion: When a feature's sole consumer is removed, sweep its supporting fields and component branches in the same change

findings.issue: The keyed each includes the index in the key (`${row.name}-${row.level}-${i}`), so keys are unstable under re-sorting and rows lose DOM identity
findings.suggestion: Key on stable row identity (name+level is already unique thanks to the `seen` dedupe in the load); drop the index

findings.issue: Boolean `link` prop duplicated in TypeBadge and TypeList is mild flag-parameter creep
findings.suggestion: Acceptable at this size; if a third variant appears, switch to snippet-based or per-variant composition

findings.issue: URL/debounce sync (goto, afterNavigate type check, manual timer) is subtle and confined to inline handlers; future filter changes must respect this dance
findings.suggestion: Extract `applyFilters`/`onSearchInput` into a small `filters.svelte.ts` module with the href builder so the sync rules are named and testable

summary: A cleanly layered SvelteKit app: API access, caching and base-URL knowledge live entirely in one server module, pages receive narrow typed data, and components are small and data-driven, so most bug fixes land in one helper. The main editability costs are the duplicated card construction between the home load and cardsFor, a monolithic home load, and the non-standard `#lib/*` import alias. Extending with an Items section or changing the data source would be easy; sorting and card-shape changes need two coordinated edits.
